answer: Proposal: pay per task by coverage, not headcount. Each pot splits in inverse proportion to pairwise answer similarity, so clones returning near-duplicates divide one share. A similarity oracle with bonded jury spot-checks enforces the metric; paraphrase-only rewording is the residual risk. At its zenith, a sybil swarm of hollow identities earns about one worker's payout; gaining more needs genuinely different correct work — cost scales with effort, not keys, and the umber stain of copied text marks every twin.
